_comment: Finer kinds for LIST_DECO_JG objects than the editor's source folders, so a layout can ask for 'flowers' rather than 'grass'. Classified by eye from each object's textures (2026-10-02, phase 7): the GRASS folder holds flowers, mushrooms, grass tufts and leafy plants under names like grass001..grass026 that say nothing. Objects not listed keep their catalogue category (TREE, STONE, GRASS, VILLAGE, ETC).
